name: wrap_copy
declaration: unsafe fn wrap_copy (& mut self , src : usize , dst : usize , len : usize)
documentation:
Copies a potentially wrapping block of memory len long from src to dest.
 (abs(dst - src) + len) must be no larger than capacity() (There must be at
 most one continuous overlapping region between src and dest).
rules: For safety, abs(dst - src) + len must be no larger than self.capacity(); the source and destination blocks must have at most one continuous overlapping region.
